title: Bentuk Kota
tagline: Measures the street layouts of 33 Indonesian neighbourhoods twice — once by car, once on foot — because the standard academic metric only sees the driving network and misreads a kampung completely

metrics.label: Sites, each measured as two networks: drive and walk
Candidate centres surveyed across 56 cities to pick them
Tests, incl. synthetic networks with known answers
Runtime deps — graph maths and SVG are hand-written
